MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink assortment complements my wire connectors by helping insulate connections across several wire sizes, making it useful without requiring one exact repair.",
    "The small quick-mixing epoxy fits my occasional repair needs and connects naturally with my past tape and vinyl cement purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs, screws, and washers require particular wire sizes or fastening jobs that I have not shown a need for; general repair interest is not enough to make those exact specifications useful now.",
    "The grinding discs and cutting wheels assume equipment and projects my purchases do not establish, while the calipers address a precision-measuring need I do not currently have.",
    "Twelve tubes of super glue feel excessive for an unspecified repair, and I would choose the small quick-setting epoxy before also buying the steel-reinforced alternative."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hose clamps and connectors seem to have been taken as interest in a broad range of workshop supplies, although I choose items for particular practical uses.",
    "My adhesive purchases suggest repair needs, but they do not mean I want every adhesive type or a large supply of each."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "An assortment that complements supplies I already bought is more useful to me than a specialized part whose exact dimensions may not fit anything I am repairing.",
    "Quantity depends on the item and intended use: my past bulk tape purchase does not mean I need twelve tubes of glue.",
    "My purchases span years, so an older connector or adhesive purchase is a clue to possible usefulness rather than proof that the same project is still active."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my practical repair interests, but too often treated them as a current need for specialized workshop supplies."
}
